name: Shoreline Marina
say: The city marina in downtown Long Beach, behind its own breakwater, with fuel and guest slips.

ashore.name: the waterfront village
ashore.say: Fish tacos on the boardwalk, with the Queen Mary across the harbor.

name: Alamitos Bay
say: The marina at the east end of Long Beach, in through the jetties. Fuel dock and launch ramp.

ashore.name: the bait barge and the fuel dock
ashore.say: A scoop of live sardines and a full tank before the sun is up.

name: Avalon
say: The town harbor, full of moorings under the round white Casino. Sheltered from the westerly, open to a north-easter.

ashore.name: the green pier
ashore.say: Swordfish on the scale at the end of the pier, and an ice cream on Crescent Avenue.

name: Avalon fuel dock
say: The fuel float under the bluff on the Casino side of the bay, with the harbor patrol alongside. Fuel, water and ice.

ashore.name: the fuel dock, and the harbormaster on the pier
ashore.say: Fill the tanks, then walk round the bay to the office at the end of the green pier to pay for the mooring.

name: Casino Point
say: Descanso Bay, just round the point from the harbor, under the Casino. The dive park is the roped-off water on the point itself.

ashore.name: the Casino and the dive park
ashore.say: Up the stairs from the dive park to the Casino terrace: twelve storeys of white wall and a red roof, and kelp and garibaldi in the water below.

name: White's Landing
say: The longest sand beach on the front side, three miles up from Avalon, with moorings off it and a camp at each end.

ashore.name: the beach at White's Landing
ashore.say: White sand, a volleyball net and nobody much. Swim in off the boat.

name: Isthmus Cove, Two Harbors
say: The cove on the front side of the Isthmus, with moorings and a pier. The island is half a mile wide here.

ashore.name: the bar at the head of the pier
ashore.say: A buffalo milk on the deck, sand on the floor, and everybody's dinghy on the beach.

name: Two Harbors pier
say: The float at the end of the pier in Isthmus Cove. Fuel, water, and the shoreboat.

ashore.name: the pier at Two Harbors
ashore.say: Up the pier past the dinghies to the only street in town, which is sand.

name: Catalina Harbor
say: The long inlet on the back side of the Isthmus, the best all-weather anchorage on the island. Good mud, and a walk across to the bar.

ashore.name: the head of Cat Harbor
ashore.say: Pull the dinghy up on the mud and walk the half mile across the Isthmus to the bar.

name: Emerald Bay
say: A shallow green bay toward the West End, behind Indian Rock, with moorings over sand and the clearest water on the island.

ashore.name: the beach at Emerald Bay
ashore.say: Over the side with a mask: sand, eelgrass and bat rays under the boat.
